goal: Measure whether the current micro scheduler remains terminal while its proof-carrying resource usage exhibits concerning growth on increasing-size truth-blind hard-family ladders.

resource_growth_obstruction_contract.hard_failure: Any observed resource exceeds the existing explicit H polynomial meter envelope on its own instance.
resource_growth_obstruction_contract.growth_warning: A finite ladder may be flagged as SUPERPOLYNOMIAL_GROWTH_CANDIDATE only if the same family has at least four increasing size levels and the endpoint-normalized doubling ratio is inconsistent with all preregistered degrees d=1..8 by the finite diagnostic below.
resource_growth_obstruction_contract.finite_diagnostic: For each resource and degree d in 1..8, compute max_n resource(n)/max(1,n^d) over family medians. If the normalized sequence is monotonically increasing at every available size and endpoint ratio >=4, mark DEGREE_d_NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_THIS_FINITE_LADDER. Only if this holds for all d=1..8 may SUPERPOLYNOMIAL_GROWTH_CANDIDATE be emitted.
resource_growth_obstruction_contract.theorem_firewall: Finite growth diagnostics are not asymptotic lower bounds and do not prove super-polynomial runtime.

pass_fail.PASS_NO_RESOURCE_OBSTRUCTION: No Q falsifier, no explicit H-envelope violation, and no preregistered superpolynomial-growth candidate.
pass_fail.RESOURCE_OBSTRUCTION_FOUND: At least one explicit H-envelope violation or Q falsifier.
pass_fail.SUPERPOLYNOMIAL_GROWTH_CANDIDATE: Finite preregistered degree-1..8 diagnostic triggered without claiming theorem.
